title: Acoustic & Audio Equipment
painPoint: Audio equipment manufacturers face rising demands for miniaturized drivers with higher sensitivity and lower distortion, where NdFeB magnet performance directly determines sound quality. Standard N42 grades often suffer flux instability under thermal stress in compact tweeters and in-ear monitors operating above 80°C. Engineers struggle with inconsistent magnetic flux density across production batches causing frequency response variations, while low-coercivity magnets experience irreversible demagnetization in high-power woofers during sustained bass transients. Achieving tight magnetic gap tolerances for voice coil alignment remains critical, yet supply chain inconsistency in plating quality and dimensional precision leads to corrosion failures and unit-to-unit performance deviation in premium speaker production lines.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU supplies precision NdFeB magnets engineered for acoustic applications, offering N48 and N52 grades for maximum sensitivity in tweeters and in-ear monitors, alongside 42SH and 38SH grades for high-temperature high-power woofers resisting thermal demagnetization. Multi-layer Ni-Cu-Ni plating provides salt-spray resistance exceeding 72 hours, preventing corrosion in humid environments. Automated Hall-sensor flux mapping on every magnet guarantees batch uniformity for consistent frequency response curves.
